info.title: Kling 4.0
info.description: Generate videos from text, first and last frames, or visual references, and edit an existing video.

text-to-video.summary: Generate video from a text prompt

input.prompt: A paper boat floats through a miniature city at sunset.

reference-image.summary: Guide the video with a reference image

input.prompt: The character in @image_1 walks along a sunlit forest trail.

reference-video.summary: Guide movement with a reference video

input.prompt: Recreate the camera movement from @video_1 in a snowy mountain landscape.

image-to-video.summary: Animate a starting image and an optional ending image

input.prompt: The camera moves from the sunlit garden to the lantern-lit courtyard.

multi-shot.summary: Describe separate shots instead of one prompt

multi_prompt.prompt: A paper boat passes beneath a bridge.
The camera rises above the river.

image-subject.summary: Guide a subject with a frontal view and reference views

input.prompt: @Element1 walks through the city square shown in @Image1.

video-subject.summary: Guide a subject with one reference video

video-edit.summary: Edit a video while retaining its original duration

input.prompt: Replace the background with a snowy mountain landscape while keeping the camera movement.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure notifications.

input.description: Selects editing when video_url is supplied, reference-to-video when reference images, reference videos, or subjects are supplied, image-to-video when only image_urls is supplied, and text-to-video otherwise. Generation requires exactly one of prompt and multi_prompt; editing requires prompt. All media URLs must be publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

prompt.description: Video instructions containing at least one non-whitespace character. Provide either prompt or multi_prompt, never both. Editing requires prompt. Reference images, videos, and subjects as @Image1, @Video1, and @Element1 in array order. Existing @image_1 and @video_1 references remain supported.

duration.description: Output duration in whole seconds. Ordinary generation defaults to 5 seconds; multi-shot generation follows the shot total. When supplied with multi_prompt, must equal the shot total. In editing, omit this field to retain the source video duration; chargeable output duration is rounded up to whole seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio for text and reference modes. When omitted, adapts to supplied materials; without materials, defaults to 16:9. Do not provide this field in image or editing modes.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 10 publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS reference images. Reference them as @Image1, @Image2, and so on; existing @image_1 references remain supported. In reference mode, these images and the optional starting frame together cannot exceed 10 images. Supported in reference and editing modes.

reference_video_urls.description: Up to 5 publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS reference videos, each lasting 3-30 seconds. Reference them as @Video1, @Video2, and so on; existing @video_1 references remain supported. Reference videos and video-based subjects must have a combined original duration of at most 30 seconds. Do not provide this field in editing mode.

image_urls.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS image URLs, starting frame first and optional ending frame second. Without references, selects image-to-video. In reference mode, at most one starting frame is allowed and counts toward the 10-image and 15-material limits. Do not provide this field in editing mode.

video_url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS source video for editing, lasting 3-30 seconds. Selects editing mode. Supports reference images and image-based subjects; cannot be combined with image_urls, reference_video_urls, video-based subjects, multi_prompt, or aspect_ratio.

prompt.description: Instructions for this shot, containing at least one non-whitespace character.

duration.description: Duration of this shot in whole seconds.

multi_prompt.description: Alternative to prompt for generation modes. Shot durations, including omitted durations defaulting to 5 seconds each, must total 3-30 seconds. If top-level duration is provided, it must equal that total. Cannot be combined with prompt or video_url.

items.description: Provide exactly one of element_input_urls and element_input_video_urls. Subjects use array positions, such as @Element1, and require no names.

element_input_urls.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS images of this subject: frontal view first, followed by 1-3 additional reference views. Supported in reference and editing modes.

element_input_video_urls.description: Exactly one publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS subject video lasting 3-30 seconds. At most 3 subjects may use videos. Reference videos and subject videos must total at most 30 seconds. Not supported in editing mode.

kling_elements.description: Up to 7 position-based subjects. Use @Element1, @Element2, and so on in the prompt. Starting frames, reference images, reference videos, and subjects combined cannot exceed 15 materials; images inside a subject count as one subject. At most 3 subjects may use videos. Editing supports image-based subjects only.
